description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise bakery that bakes all products fresh on-site every day with no frozen or refrigerated products used. The Fort St. John location offers a broad range of breads, loaves, buns, rolls, bagels, scones, croissants, and savoury items including pizzas and buffins. As part of a community-focused brand, any leftover baked goods are donated to local charities at the end of each day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The COBS Bread website corroborates the OSM address (Unit 102, 9317 96 St, Fort St John, BC V1J 6V5), phone (+1 250-794-9399), and confirms an active franchise bakery location with full operating hours listed. The 'Closed Opens tomorrow' on the website is a real-time status indicator, not a permanent closure. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or website content; the products page confirms a range of baked goods (breads, loaves, buns, rolls, bagels, scones, savoury items) that qualify as food staples.
concerns: Website displays 'Closure reason text' as a literal string alongside the current-day closed status, suggesting a possible template rendering issue on the store locator page; does not indicate permanent closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible franchise bakery in Fort St. John with confirmed contact details; a practical food stop for touring cyclists passing through.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=bakery; more precisely a bakery than a general grocery store, though it sells food staples useful to cyclists.
